best_fine.scope: Full declared episode, all steps/actions, zero sampled falls and exact original physical prefix parity excluding wall timing. This is a same-model speed measurement, not numerical convergence, hardware accuracy or a physical maximum.

best_third_resolution.scope: Matched300s refinement changes only timestep and associated step/report/command indices. Entire scene, commands, seed, requested steps and zero sampled falls verified. Different timesteps are not expected to produce identical trajectories; this comparison does not establish convergence or physical maximum speed.
